name: Drug Trafficking and Precursor Chemicals (incl. Synthetic Opioids)
description: Production and trafficking of illicit drugs, diversion of precursor chemicals and sale of synthetic opioids, generating cash proceeds that are placed and moved through retail accounts, trade, couriers and professional money launderers. Chemical and equipment purchases, online sales and pill-press activity are additional signals.

sources.text: UNODC, World Drug Report (annual; specify year)
INCB, Precursors and Chemicals Frequently Used in the Illicit Manufacture of Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (annual report; specify year)
FinCEN, Advisory to Financial Institutions on Illicit Financial Schemes and Methods Related to the Trafficking of Fentanyl and Other Synthetic Opioids (FIN-2019-A006, 2019)

exposure.rationale: Cash deposits from multiple locations, precursor purchases and IVTS/trade.

indicators.name: Structured cash deposits across many branches by multiple people
indicators.canon: Cash deposits split across branches, ATMs or accounts
indicators.desc: Cash is deposited in several locations, channels or accounts on the same day or over a short period so that no single deposit stands out.
indicators.ctx: Many low-value cash deposits into one account from different locations, often followed by wires out.

indicators.name: Bulk purchases of precursor chemicals or lab equipment
indicators.canon: Bulk purchases of precursor chemicals or lab equipment
indicators.desc: Customer buys large chemical quantities, pill presses or glassware inconsistent with stated business.
indicators.ctx: Customer buys large chemical quantities, pill presses or glassware inconsistent with stated business.
indicators.fp: Industrial and academic buyers legitimately purchase chemicals.

indicators.name: Import-export firms trading chemicals with unusual consignees
indicators.canon: Import-export firms trading chemicals with unusual consignees
indicators.desc: Importers deal with unfamiliar overseas parties in high-risk corridors for precursor sources.
indicators.ctx: Importers deal with unfamiliar overseas parties in high-risk corridors for precursor sources.
indicators.fp: Chemical trade is large and lawful.

indicators.name: Cash couriering or bulk cash seizures linked to customer
indicators.canon: Cash couriering or bulk cash seizures linked to customer
indicators.desc: Customer or associates tied to seized cash or declarations.
indicators.ctx: Customer or associates tied to seized cash or declarations.
indicators.fp: Cash is legal to carry within limits.

indicators.name: Chinese-underground-banking or mirror-transaction style offsets
indicators.canon: Mirror or offsetting transactions between jurisdictions
indicators.desc: Reciprocal or offsetting payments occur between counterparties or operators in different countries with no direct value transfer.
indicators.ctx: Payments settled by matching transactions in different countries without cross-border transfers.

indicators.name: Proceeds spent on assets, vehicles or in casinos and then converted
indicators.canon: Proceeds spent on assets, vehicles or in casinos and then converted
indicators.desc: Lifestyle spending and asset purchases funded by cash.
indicators.ctx: Lifestyle spending and asset purchases funded by cash.
indicators.fp: Lifestyle may come from legitimate income.

indicators.name: Dark-web or social media sales with crypto or payment app proceeds
indicators.canon: Illicit sales or services advertised on social media or marketplaces with app or crypto payments
indicators.desc: Informal sellers or operators advertise online and collect payment through payment apps, crypto or unlabelled payments.
indicators.ctx: Receipt of numerous small payments from unrelated persons and crypto conversions to cash.

indicators.name: Pharmacy, clinic or online pharmacy with abnormal opioid volumes
indicators.canon: Pharmacy, clinic or online pharmacy with abnormal opioid volumes
indicators.desc: Dispensing, imports or payments exceeding peers for controlled substances.
indicators.ctx: Dispensing, imports or payments exceeding peers for controlled substances.
indicators.fp: Specialist clinics may have high volumes.

indicators.name: Shell companies buying pill presses or tableting equipment
indicators.canon: Newly formed entity with vague purpose and large flows
indicators.desc: Recently incorporated entity or group of entities with generic business descriptions shows significant turnover or purchases soon after formation.
indicators.ctx: New firm purchases machines and packaging with no production site.
